# Travis Lenkner featured in European Law Institute newsletter


November 14, 2024


-
-
-
-


Burford's Chief Development Officer[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) is featured in a Spotlight article in the September-October edition of the European Law Institute (ELI) newsletter. The article examines ELI's principles governing legal finance.


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.europeanlawinstitute.eu/fileadmin/user_upload/p_eli/Newsletter/2024/Newlsetter_Sep-Oct.pdf)
